quality_scope: All validation images and unseen class combinations from the matched experiment; equal tasks, equal class sides, equal images within each side, then mean of all three fixed training seeds. Timing-pool accuracy is not used.
quality_uncertainty: Where present, archived 95% image-cluster intervals condition on the fixed tasks and seeds. They are not across-seed intervals.
latency_scope: GPU-resident preprocessed image to candidate-class cosine scores; includes full prefix, online selection and suffix. Excludes CPU preprocessing, H2D input transfer and one-time text encoding.
latency_aggregation: Wall-clock median, IQR and p95 pool equal numbers of calls across all fixed seeds. Speedup uses native-full versus method medians paired by round; all seeds and rounds retained. Quantiles describe timing variability and are not confidence intervals.
contended_window_policy: All measurements remain in tables/figures. A foreign compute process observed before or after a round invalidates the batch-size timing window; speedup fields remain empty. No fastest-window selection.

latency.quality_scope: Full validation evaluation from evaluation_source; timing-pool outcomes are not used as an accuracy benchmark.
latency.measurement_scope: GPU-resident preprocessed images and candidate-class indices to two cosine scores. Includes complete image encoder, online descriptor/selector, stable GPU ranking, spatial sort, gather and suffix. No image-prefix cache, request reuse, hidden padding, compilation, CUDA graphs or model fusion.
latency.primary_clock: CUDA-synchronized Python wall clock per request; CUDA events are supplementary.
latency.text_policy: Cached individual class embeddings, identical across methods; online pair lookup/descriptor included.
latency.batch_construction: Contiguous complete batches from the seeded panel; each method/seed receives the same input sequence in each round. Unique timed-image counts are recorded separately from the pool size.

1.invalid_window_policy: All raw timings retained. Speedup summary withheld if another compute process was observed; reruns require a separately recorded window.

32.invalid_window_policy: All raw timings retained. Speedup summary withheld if another compute process was observed; reruns require a separately recorded window.

latency.contention_check_limit: Compute-process snapshots before and after each round; they cannot rule out a transient process entirely inside a round. All samples are retained; no fastest-run selection.
